verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for desktop remote-access software like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The pack covers pricing, features, AI assistants and community complaints, none of which address telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
